description: This file contains functions for parsing and validating Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), including extracting CRL data, checking signatures, and verifying revocation status of certificates within a security framework.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Structure representing the parsed TBSCertList part of a CRL, including fields like version, signature algorithm, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CRL into its components: TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertList part of a CRL, extracting version, signature, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Validates a CRL against a certificate chain and distribution point, checking signatures, issuer match, revocation status, and CRL validity dates.
